name: coop-spell-caster
description: Use a registered co-op projectile caster only for the original HChar Flipendo shove; preserve single-player fallback and persistent enemy PlayerHarry context.
format_note: ASCII JSON. Encode old/new strings as latin-1; preserve LF source bytes. Apply only to a marked development copy via scripts/apply_patches.py.
scope: HChar.HandleSpellFlipendo only; no map, AI target, enemy state, health, damage or movement changes.
Authority co-op: prefer registered spell.Instigator; fallback to registered spell.Owner. If neither qualifies, retain original PlayerHarry.
All non-co-op calls, client calls, absent/deleted spells and unregistered casters keep original PlayerHarry direction.
Existing Super callback, bFlipPushable gate, PHYS_Falling, XY magnitude, Z force and return are preserved.
known_gaps: firecrab.pushDirection still uses canonical PlayerHarry for subsequent ledge decisions.
Co-op enemy AI target selection and target vulnerability replication remain separate work.
